claim: AutoDock's rotary parking, charging, OS, and fleet-orchestration statements are company claims.
evidence_summary: The company site presents these capabilities; its terms say products are in development and specifications, capacities, pilot cities, and timelines are indicative.
conflict_note: Home/product pages differ on retrieval times and describe current AC versus proposed Gen 3 DC configurations.
research_note: No independent US deployment, customer, integration, rights document, or measured result was established in this run.

claim: A commercial AV depot is already a real operating facility category.
evidence_summary: Lyft says Flexdrive opened an 80,000-square-foot Nashville AV depot for Waymo vehicles, with fast charging, maintenance bays, and parts storage.
research_note: The announcement verifies the operator's stated facility and scope, not audited utilization or capex.

claim: Depot work combines charging, maintenance, parts, and labor rather than parking alone.
evidence_summary: The Nashville depot announcement describes dozens of fast chargers, maintenance bays, secure parts storage, and more than 70 full-time jobs.
research_note: Supports workflow complexity; does not show that robotic parking would reduce labor or cost.

claim: At least one operator chose to co-locate depot, charging, maintenance, and fleet-management functions.
evidence_summary: Waymo identifies Flexdrive as its Nashville fleet-management partner; Lyft describes the Nashville depot as serving and maintaining Waymo vehicles.
research_note: One deployment is not evidence that co-location is optimal for every operator or city.

claim: Waymo has active expansion signals and uses outside fleet/depot partners.
evidence_summary: Waymo's current blog reports service in more than ten US cities; its Dallas announcement named Avis for infrastructure, readiness, maintenance, and depot operations.
conflict_note: The 2025 Dallas announcement used future tense; use Waymo's current page for current service status.
research_note: No city-level fleet count or depot capacity was found in the verified sources used here.

claim: Zoox has a live Las Vegas service and a narrower San Francisco access program.
evidence_summary: Zoox announced public service around the Las Vegas Strip; its San Francisco page describes an Explorers/waitlist service area.
conflict_note: Do not label the San Francisco Explorers program as broad paid commercial service.
research_note: Vehicle and operations model differs from conventional driver-operated EV fleets.

claim: Motional and Uber announced Las Vegas app matching with electric IONIQ 5 vehicles.
evidence_summary: The March 2026 announcement sets out defined pickup areas and matching through Uber; it does not say every ride is driverless.
research_note: Classify as robotaxi/AV service with driverless status unknown until supported by a regulator or current operator statement.

claim: Tesla currently lists limited Robotaxi service in six US metro areas.
evidence_summary: Tesla's support page lists areas in Miami, Orlando, Tampa, Austin, Dallas, and Houston; TxDMV separately lists Tesla Robotaxi LLC as authorized in Texas.
research_note: No fleet size, depot footprint, or third-party depot purchasing evidence was established.

claim: The Lucid-Nuro-Uber robotaxi program was at supervised testing and planned-launch stage in its January announcement.
evidence_summary: The companies announced supervised autonomous road testing and an expected Bay Area launch later in 2026.
research_note: This source does not establish whether the planned launch subsequently occurred.

claim: Conventional parking-structure construction is a material cost benchmark, but not a depot cost quote.
evidence_summary: WGI reported a 2026 US median of $33,300 per parking space ($98.75/sq ft) across 35 markets.
research_note: Excludes no costs unless confirmed in the 2026 report; do not add this to land, utility, or equipment as if it were a full depot estimate.

claim: Fleet charging design depends on duty cycle, charger mix, electrical service, and time at depot.
evidence_summary: DOE AFDC advises compatibility checks and notes tradeoffs between Level 2 overnight charging and DC fast charging for in-shift use.
research_note: Robotaxi duty cycles and charger utilization remain operator-specific unknowns.

claim: Managed charging can reduce grid-upgrade exposure and energy costs when it has operational data.
evidence_summary: DOE guidance ties smart charging to vehicle schedule, battery state of charge, dwell periods, charger data, and tariffs.
research_note: Benefit size for robotaxi depots is not quantified by this source.

claim: Depot charging optimization evidence exists for other fleet classes, but should not be copied into robotaxi economics.
evidence_summary: A DOE-sponsored study modeled 100 California medium/heavy-duty trucks and reported lower peak load and variable energy costs under managed schedules.
research_note: Cross-domain analogy only; different vehicles, duty cycles, chargers, and rates.

claim: Utility service and interconnection are material site dependencies.
evidence_summary: PG&E's Power Ready pathway covers dedicated separately metered EV service; the customer buys chargers and agrees to operate them for five years.
research_note: Eligibility, capacity, timeline, and customer cost are site-specific and unresolved for any candidate site.

claim: California operator access requires distinguishing DMV AV permits from CPUC passenger-service approvals.
evidence_summary: DMV publishes testing/deployment permit categories, while CPUC publishes driverless passenger-service advice letters and dispositions.
research_note: Permit status is operator- and service-specific and changes over time.

claim: Texas requires authorization for commercial driverless AV operation from May 28, 2026.
evidence_summary: TxDMV says commercial driverless operators must maintain authorization and submit emergency-services interaction planning.
research_note: This is a vehicle-operation rule; it does not resolve local site, building, fire, or utility approvals.

claim: Arizona's driverless operation process includes law-enforcement interaction planning and compliance statements.
evidence_summary: ADOT describes required filings before operating without a safety driver.
research_note: Site construction and local approvals are separate.

claim: San Francisco fleet-charging land use can require parcel-level zoning review.
evidence_summary: A city appeals record discusses conditional-use authorization for fleet charging in specified PDR districts under the cited ordinance.
research_note: The case record is not a parcel determination or complete code opinion.

claim: Automated parking has existing US deployments, including systems with some EV charging, but those examples are not robotaxi depots.
evidence_summary: ParkPlus lists a 411-space Miami automated system with 80 charging-capable spaces and other completed projects.
research_note: Vendor project portfolio; no independently verified throughput, retrieval, uptime, or cost data.

claim: Charging infrastructure firms may be partners or substitutes for AutoDock's site and energy layer.
evidence_summary: Terawatt markets autonomous/rideshare charging sites and Prologis markets dedicated fleet charging through logistics real estate.
research_note: No evidence that either currently integrates robotic vehicle storage with robotaxi orchestration.

claim: Public evidence in this first pass does not establish an integrated US deployment combining robotic vehicle storage, charging, and robotaxi fleet orchestration.
evidence_summary: Searches surfaced separate parking-system vendors, fleet depot operators, and charging providers, but no verified combined deployment record.
research_note: This is a bounded search result, not proof that no such deployment exists.

claim: A defensible TAM/SAM/SOM dollar estimate is not ready from this corpus.
evidence_summary: Public fleet/site counts, addressable depot counts, tower installed prices, service costs, and operator procurement rates are missing or not comparable.
research_note: Keep formulas and editable assumptions visible; do not publish a fabricated market total.

claim: No public data in the curated sources establishes robotaxi depot utilization, charging dwell, empty miles, or a robotic-parking payback.
evidence_summary: Operator announcements describe facility scope and service rollout but omit the operational and financial data needed for these calculations.
research_note: Resolve through operator interviews and site data under an agreed data-sharing process.
